title: Introduce KMS usage policy harmonizer and audit epochizer for region-pinned retention
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Customers in multiple jurisdictions require consistent enforcement of KMS key usage policies and predictable audit retention windows tied to region pinning. This PR introduces two coordinated components: (1) a KMS Usage Policy Harmonizer that normalizes and evaluates operator/service-level KMS usage against jurisdictional allowlists and fallback rules, and (2) an Audit Epochizer that embeds an immutable retention-epoch annotation into audit events so downstream retention processors can make deterministic retention and export decisions. The goal is to reduce policy drift between RBAC v2 decisions and KMS routing, surface mismatches as explicit telemetry, and provide a safe migration path for existing region-pin config. Changes: added harmonizer and epochizer services, RBAC timebound lock support, migration compatibility shims, feature flag gating, and observability hooks (metrics/traces). Migration notes: default behavior is off behind feature flag compliance.kms_harmonizer.enabled=false. Rolling migration steps included in the PR description and docs. Testing: unit tests + integration harness covering region-pin fallback and a simulated multi-KMS routing scenario. Impact/Risks: low-risk rollout while gated; possible latency increase on first request per-operator due to cache fill (mitigated by warmup job). See linked Linear tickets for rollout checklist.
